title: TIMELAPSE OF THE FUTURE: A Journey to the End of Time (4K)
summary: A 29-minute cinematic timelapse by melodysheep that journeys trillions of years into the future, covering the death of the sun, the end of stars, proton decay, black hole evaporation and the fate of the cosmos.
why: HN people recommend it as a stunning, mind-bending and existentially humbling view of deep time, and it appears on lists of favorite YouTube videos.

quote.text: does a great job with visuals and voiceovers about what will happen over the next trillions x trillions of years
